DocumentIR.notes: DocumentIR is the only object fully wired into the production pipeline

ModuleResult.notes: Created in document_ir and ocr_adapter but NOT consumed by pipeline_orchestrator or main stages

OcrAdapter.notes: Protocol defined but never called from production OCR paths

DocumentTransformAdapter.notes: Protocol defined but never called from production transform paths

OCRRequest.notes: Defined but never used by any OCR caller

AdapterRegistry.notes: Defined but never queried by pipeline

AdapterSelector.notes: Defined but never called by pipeline

AdapterCapabilities.notes: Defined but never evaluated outside own module

CircuitBreaker.notes: Defined but NEVER used anywhere in the codebase

critical_findings: Pipeline orchestrator uses DocumentIR but NOT OcrAdapter, ModuleResult, or AdapterSelector
structure_freeze_stage uses DocumentIR but NOT new adapter contracts
No production path calls AdapterRegistry.select() or AdapterSelector.select()
ModuleResult instances in reading_order_stage not consumed by pipeline
Adapter implementations exist but are never instantiated in production code
